G1.name: Sample size
G1.criterion: n >= 300 graded bets and out-of-sample n >= 100

G2.name: Significance
G2.criterion: p < 0.05 and BH q < 0.10, in the profitable direction (ROI > 0)

G4.name: Robustness
G4.criterion: ROI > 0 at -115 and >= 60% of seasons non-negative

G5.name: Economic edge
G5.criterion: mean CLV > 0 if measurable, else OOS ROI > 2%

G6.name: Risk
G6.criterion: max drawdown <= 25 units and per-bet Sharpe > 0

G7.name: Inputs available
G7.criterion: all rule inputs are public pre-game data

closing_spread_within_1pt.note: sign-flipped comparison; a gap means different books/snapshots

g0_data_integrity.criteria: zero final-score disagreements on the 2021 overlap, closing total within 1 point on >= 90% of games, >= 2800 usable games

strategies.name: Model spread edge >= 2 pts
strategies.description: Bet the side the originated line favours when it differs from the closing spread by at least the threshold.
strategies.rule_note: Uses the walk-forward model line from 02_line_model.py; bet at the closing line, so no CLV is measurable.

strategies.name: Model spread edge >= 3.5 pts
strategies.description: Bet the side the originated line favours when it differs from the closing spread by at least the threshold.
strategies.rule_note: Uses the walk-forward model line from 02_line_model.py; bet at the closing line, so no CLV is measurable.

strategies.name: Fade the move >= 1.5 pts of opening-to-closing movement
strategies.description: Bet against (fade) or with (follow) a spread that moved at least 1.5 points between the opening and closing number.
strategies.rule_note: The bet is placed at the closing line, which is the realistic execution point for a retail bettor reacting to a move.

strategies.name: Follow the move >= 1.5 pts of opening-to-closing movement
strategies.description: Bet against (fade) or with (follow) a spread that moved at least 1.5 points between the opening and closing number.
strategies.rule_note: The bet is placed at the closing line, which is the realistic execution point for a retail bettor reacting to a move.

strategies.name: Home underdog +3 to +7 (opening line)
strategies.description: Back the home team when the opening spread puts it between +3 and +7.
strategies.rule_note: Bet at the opening line, so closing-line value is measurable. Tested because it is widely claimed, not because it looked good in this data.

strategies.name: Back the team coming off a bye (opening line)
strategies.description: Any team whose previous game was 13+ days earlier is backed ATS.
strategies.rule_note: Bye weeks are detected from the gap between consecutive game dates, not from a schedule file, so it cannot leak future information.

strategies.name: Fade the short-rest road team (opening line)
strategies.description: Back the home team when the visitor played 6 or fewer days earlier (Thursday games and short weeks).
strategies.rule_note: Rest is computed from prior game dates only.

strategies.name: Back the team with 4+ extra rest days (opening line)
strategies.description: Bet the side with at least four more rest days than its opponent.
strategies.rule_note: Bet at the opening line so CLV is measurable.

strategies.name: Fade a 3+ game win streak (opening line)
strategies.description: Bet against any team entering the game on a run of three or more straight wins.

strategies.name: Model total edge >= 3 pts
strategies.description: Bet Over/Under when the pace model's total differs from the closing total by 3+ points.

strategies.name: Under the highest-decile totals
strategies.description: Bet the contrarian side of the season's most extreme totals, testing the public preference for high-scoring games.

strategies.name: Over the lowest-decile totals
strategies.description: Bet the contrarian side of the season's most extreme totals, testing the public preference for high-scoring games.

strategies.name: Underdogs priced +200 to +400 (win only)
strategies.description: Flat-stake moneyline bets inside a single price bucket, used to measure the favourite-longshot bias directly on realised returns.
strategies.rule_note: Priced at the actual archived moneyline, so the vig is included exactly as traded.

strategies.name: Favourites priced -150 to -250 (win only)
strategies.description: Flat-stake moneyline bets inside a single price bucket, used to measure the favourite-longshot bias directly on realised returns.
strategies.rule_note: Priced at the actual archived moneyline, so the vig is included exactly as traded.

strategies.name: Moneyline edge >= 5 pts over the de-margined price
strategies.description: Bet the moneyline when the model's win probability exceeds the proportional no-vig market probability by at least 5 percentage points.
strategies.rule_note: This is the strictest model test: it must clear the full bookmaker margin.

strategies.name: Under when both offences are running hot (opening line)
strategies.description: Bet Under when the two teams' exponentially weighted scoring form averages 55+ combined points per game entering the week.
strategies.rule_note: Form is computed from prior games only (half-life 6 games).

strategies.name: Model spread edge >= 2 pts vs the OPENING line
strategies.description: Same edge rule as S01 but executed at the opening number, which is the only way to earn closing-line value on a model signal.
strategies.rule_note: CLV is measured against the close.

strategies.name: Divisional underdog (opening line)
strategies.description: Back the underdog in a divisional game, where familiarity and short travel are often claimed to compress the market's edge.
strategies.rule_note: Divisions are the 2026 NFL alignment (see SOURCES: NFL-DIVISIONS).

luck.interpretation: Correlation between each strategy's in-sample ROI (2012-2017) and its held-out ROI (2018-2021) across the whole battery. A skill-based family shows positive persistence; a family that is mostly luck shows ~0 or negative.
luck.luck_ratio_definition: luck_ratio = (k-1)/Q. ~1 means season-to-season ROI dispersion is fully explained by binomial sampling noise.

settings.method: CLT normal approximation to the exact binomial (cross-checked)
CLT normal approximation to the exact binomial (cross-checked)

settings.clv_sd_source: empirical pooled sd of per-bet CLV across the battery (data/strategies.json)
